messages:
maya: Quick check — planning a small Dedicated burst pool for a customer demo next week. Need a 4-GPU mix (2x H100, 2x A100) in ap-northeast1 for burst capacity. Anyone seen SKU availability from our usual vendor this week? They had spot allocations last sprint but not sure now.
kevin: @maya I checked earlier today. Vendor portal shows limited H100 spot inventory in ap-northeast1, A100 looks fine. Might need to reserve H100 as standard (no spot). Pinged vendor-eng below.
vendor-eng: hi team — short update: H100 spot nodes are tight for that region, we have ~3 racks with partial spare. We can hold 2 nodes for you if you convert to reserved for the demo window. ETA for more spots is ~10–14 days.
samir: If we take 2 reserved H100 and 2 A100 spot, what's the cost delta? procurement-bot can you pull the rough numbers (spot vs reserved for 24h burst)?
procurement-bot: Cost calc (24h burst):
```
H100 reserved x2: $1200/day
H100 spot x2: $760/day
A100 spot x2: $340/day
Estimated blended: $1600/day (reserved H100)
``` 
li: That number seems high — are we pricing per rack or per GPU? procurement-bot: per-GPU instance equivalent, includes vendor premium for guaranteed hold.
kevin: For the demo we can run a canary on 2x A100 + 1 H100 reserved; reduces cost and still validates perf. Can we also fallback to a remote region if ap-northeast is depleted?
vendor-eng: Yes, we can failover to ap-southeast with same SKU mix, but latency will differ. We can add an automated routing policy to prefer ap-northeast and fallback after 5s.
maya: Sounds reasonable. Action items: (1) @procurement-bot open a short reserve for 2 H100 for 24h on 2026-03-25 (demo window) (2) @kevin add the ap-southeast fallback policy in the routing config PR (3) vendor-eng hold the 2 nodes until EOD PT tomorrow. Anyone object?
samir: no objections. I'll also add a small smoke test to validate kv-cache warms across the mix.
kevin: I'll draft the PR now, cc @li for cost review.
vendor-eng: Holding the 2 H100 nodes until 2026-03-19 03:00 PT. If we don't confirm reserve by then we'll release to pool.
maya: Thanks — I'll confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:
